content:
Horsehead Corporation is a well-regarded name in the chemical and metals industry, widely recognized for its dedication to innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence. Located at 300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, PA 15061-2295, the company has a storied history of delivering cutting-edge solutions that serve diverse industries including construction, manufacturing, energy, and agriculture. Horsehead stands out for its expertise in zinc-related products, such as zinc oxide and zinc sulfate, which are essential components used in a wide range of applications.

The company's commitment to environmental stewardship is integral to its operations. Horsehead has invested in recycling technologies and advanced manufacturing processes to promote a sustainable, closed-loop production model. This eco-friendly approach not only helps reduce waste, but also demonstrates the company’s forward-thinking prioritization of green initiatives in an increasingly environmentally conscious world.

Strategically located in Monaca, Pennsylvania, Horsehead Corporation benefits from its proximity to major industrial hubs and extensive transportation networks, enabling efficient product distribution to clients across North America and beyond. The company’s talented team of professionals is dedicated to upholding rigorous quality standards, fostering innovation, and building long-term relationships with customers. Known for its emphasis on reliability and performance, Horsehead Corporation continues to set itself apart as a leader in the chemical and materials sector.
